channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 20
item.description:
81 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed siege weapons retaining pulling flag after a server restart and removed lingering catapult reload bars when a catapult dies mid‑reload.
  • Roof‑overhang collider inconsistencies in building skins that blocked block placement have been resolved.
  • Fixed parented wire issues on boats when exiting edit mode.

Siege & Combat

  • Fixed siege weapons retaining pulling flag after a server restart and removed lingering catapult reload bars when a catapult dies mid‑reload.
  • Stairs, ladders and spirals now correctly respect line‑of‑sight, eliminating false LOS blocks.
  • Mortar weapons no longer snap back after firing; the firing animation now plays correctly.

Building & World

  • Roof‑overhang collider inconsistencies in building skins that blocked block placement have been resolved.
  • Increased bounds of several monuments (Military tunnels, Powerplant, Trainyard, Water Treatment Plant, Launchsite) to prevent overlapping spawns and terrain clipping.
  • Terrain in the exit computer room and truck garage area repainted to stop clipping that could trap players.
  • Tunnel lights now work correctly after track spline changes, removing dark tunnels.
  • Underwater labs now generate without errors, restoring proper dungeon base links.

Equipment & Repair

  • Fixed inability to change gun accessories on the repair bench when the weapon has no skin.
  • Fixed parented wire issues on boats when exiting edit mode.

UI, HUD & Controls

  • Safe‑zone warning no longer persists on the main menu and its title is restored; upkeep labels now have proper spacing to avoid overlap, and misleading movement‑speed modifiers are hidden when leading animals or pulling siege weapons.
  • Gamepad map zoom now centers on the crosshair, and D‑pad inventory navigation has been improved for smoother item selection on controllers.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 19
item.description:
125 development commits

Crafting & Vision

  • Updated bone armour crafting values and swapped the egg vision effect for candy vision, improving crafting balance and visual experience.

Movement & Collision

  • Prevented jumping while crouched when an overhead solid object is present, eliminating head clipping and unintended explosion damage.

World & Interaction

  • Fixed colliders for gravestones, cursed cauldrons, and applied correct physics materials to wooden cross, skull fire pit, and spooky speaker, resulting in more accurate physical behavior.
  • Added a DungeonGridBlocker to canyon areas to stop underground train tunnels from spawning dangerously close and fixed cave network layer overrides in the nuclear missile silo, preventing disappearing players and NPCs on stairs.
  • Resolved an issue where NPC corpses became unlootable after a server restart, restoring access to their loot.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Frankenstein pet now respects player shields
  • Frankenstein pet no longer sinks, performs invisible attacks, kicks owners, or passes through windows
  • Radiation no longer activates immediately upon entering Halloween and Christmas dungeons
  • All lighthouses now share a single repair progress bar
  • Coconut tree spawn chance reduced to 25%; apple and beehive spawn chances on oak trees increased

UI & Quality of Life

  • Cooking workbench now shows the kettle when brewing new teas
  • Crafting UI now features a separate list for currently craftable items and an All button
  • Crafting category buttons now toggle categories instead of stacking, with an All view option

Performance & Visual

  • Ambient lights correctly turn off when reused from the pool, cutting unnecessary lighting and improving performance
  • MeshCull now hides renderers when reused, preventing distant code lock lights from staying visible
  • Particle systems respect culling, stopping distant conveyor flashes and furnace heat shimmers and saving CPU time

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 18
item.description:
11 development commits

Combat Audio

Farming & UI

Vehicle & Animal Transport
